def get_args(text: str) -> str:
    """Return the part of message following the command."""
    splitted = text.split(" ", 1)

    if not len(splitted) == 2:
        splitted = text.split("\n", 1)
        if not len(splitted) == 2:
            return ""

    prefix, args = splitted
    print(prefix)
    args = args.strip()
    print(args)
    return args
